scripts.predev: node scripts/build-user-guide.mjs && node scripts/check-version-sync.js && node scripts/check-wmap-update.js
scripts.prebuild: node scripts/build-user-guide.mjs && node scripts/check-version-sync.js && node scripts/check-changelog.mjs && node scripts/check-wmap-update.js && node scripts/check-wmap-published.js && node scripts/check-testdata-parser-published.js
scripts.prebuild:web: node scripts/build-user-guide.mjs && node scripts/check-version-sync.js && node scripts/check-changelog.mjs && node scripts/check-wmap-update.js && node scripts/check-wmap-published.js && node scripts/check-testdata-parser-published.js
scripts.build:site: npm run build:web && ${ZENSICAL:-.venv/bin/zensical} build --clean && cp -r dist site/app
scripts.build:site:dev: npm run predev && tsc && vite build && ${ZENSICAL:-.venv/bin/zensical} build --clean && cp -r dist site/app
scripts.preview:site: npm run build:site:dev && echo "\nServing site at http://localhost:8002/ — Ctrl-C to stop\n" && cd site && python3 -m http.server 8002
scripts.check:docs: node scripts/check-architecture-docs.mjs && node scripts/check-parser-docs.mjs && node scripts/check-doc-links.mjs && node scripts/help.mjs --check && node scripts/check-theme-docs.mjs && node scripts/check-theme-contrast.mjs && node scripts/check-button-styles.mjs && node scripts/check-style-scales.mjs && node scripts/check-clones.mjs src
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run lint && npm run check:docs && npm test && npm run check:rust && npm run test:rust
scripts.preversion: npm run verify && node scripts/check-wmap-published.js && node scripts/check-testdata-parser-published.js
scripts.postversion:
echo "
Tagged v$npm_package_version. Push it to start the release build:
  git push && git push origin v$npm_package_version
"
scripts.release: npm run tauri build -- --no-bundle && npm run install-bin
scripts.tauri: env -u GTK_PATH -u GTK_EXE_PREFIX -u GDK_PIXBUF_MODULE_FILE -u GDK_PIXBUF_MODULEDIR -u GIO_MODULE_DIR -u GTK_IM_MODULE_FILE -u LOCPATH tauri
scripts.wmap:link: rm -rf node_modules/@wafertools/wafermap && ln -s ../../../wafermap node_modules/@wafertools/wafermap && echo '\n  ✓ linked to ../wafermap — run `npm run build` in ../wafermap after each change so dist/ refreshes. Unlink before releasing: npm run wmap:unlink'
scripts.wmap:unlink: npm unlink @wafertools/wafermap && npm install @wafertools/wafermap && echo '\n  ✓ unlinked — restored published wmap from npm'
scripts.parser:build: wasm-pack build -t web -s wafertools --dev packages/parsers --no-default-features --features wasm && node scripts/sync-parser-pkg.mjs
scripts.parser:build:release: wasm-pack build -t web -s wafertools packages/parsers --no-default-features --features wasm && node scripts/sync-parser-pkg.mjs
scripts.parser:link: npm run parser:build && rm -rf node_modules/@wafertools/testdata-parser && ln -s ../../packages/parsers/pkg node_modules/@wafertools/testdata-parser && echo '\n  ✓ linked to packages/parsers/pkg — run `npm run parser:build` after each Rust change so the wasm bundle refreshes. Unlink before releasing: npm run parser:unlink'
scripts.parser:unlink: npm unlink @wafertools/testdata-parser && npm install @wafertools/testdata-parser && echo '\n  ✓ unlinked — restored published testdata-parser from npm'
scripts.demo:build: npm run predev && tsc && vite build
